findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_guide, list_messages, validate_message, list_samples, get_sample, explain_execution_request, verify_execution_report, list_corporate_actions, holdings_calendar, get_corporate_action · Private data: check_token_contract, get_tokenized_asset, list_corporate_actions, holdings_calendar, token_corporate_actions · Public sink: explain_execution_request, verify_execution_report, list_corporate_actions · Destructive: verify_proof, verify_execution_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_guide, list_messages, validate_message, list_samples, get_sample, explain_execution_request, verify_execution_report, list_corporate_actions, holdings_calendar, get_corporate_action · Private data: check_token_contract, get_tokenized_asset, list_corporate_actions, holdings_calendar, token_corporate_actions · Public sink: explain_execution_request, verify_execution_report, list_corporate_actions · Destructive: verify_proof, verify_execution_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
